title: ExceptionDrive: A Planning-Oriented Counterfactual Corner-Case Benchmark for Autonomous Driving
title_zh: ExceptionDrive: 一个规划导向的反事实边缘案例基准

paragraphs.en: Average performance on routine driving benchmarks does not establish planner reliability under rare, safety-critical hazards. We proposed ExceptionDrive, a counterfactual planning benchmark that uses VLM-assisted screening, localized multi-view editing, and quality auditing to insert hazards into real nuScenes scenes while preserving their context. Its 21 tasks span six safety families and define hazard or conflict regions, local safety constraints, and acceptable responses. Because hazard insertion can invalidate the recorded human trajectory, our reference-free protocol evaluates edited predictions using Unsafe Rate (UR), Hazard Clearance Compliance (HCC), Hazard Proximity Response (HPR), and Counterfactual Trajectory Shift (CTS), which measure core-region intrusion, clearance compliance, clearance relative to a prescribed margin, and counterfactual trajectory change. Seven representative planners frequently intrude into hazard regions or provide insufficient clearance. We also develop a Reminder Agent that, without sample-specific task labels, converts visual evidence and the shared taxonomy into structured records of hazard presence, type, and a recommended high-level strategy. The agent neither predicts trajectories nor controls the vehicle; its records guide a VLM-based decision agent. In zero-shot experiments, the reminders improve strategy accuracy and reduce under-warning.
paragraphs.zh: 在常规驾驶基准测试中的平均表现，并不能证明规划器在罕见且关乎安全的关键性危险情况下的可靠性。 我们提出了 ExceptionDrive——一种反事实规划基准测试，它利用 VLM 辅助筛选、局部多视角编辑和质量审核，将危险情境插入真实的 nuScenes 场景，同时保留其上下文信息。 该基准包含 21 项任务，涵盖六个安全类别，并定义了危险或冲突区域、局部安全约束以及可接受的反应方式。 由于危险情境的插入可能使记录的人类轨迹失效，我们的无参考协议通过不安全率（UR）、危险规避合规性（HCC）、危险邻近响应（HPR）和反事实轨迹偏移（CTS）来评估编辑后的预测结果，这些指标分别衡量核心区域的侵入、规避合规性、相对于规定边界的规避距离以及反事实轨迹的变化。 七种典型的规划器经常侵入危险区域或未能提供足够的规避距离。 我们还开发了一种提醒智能体，它无需针对具体样本的任务标签，即可将视觉证据和共享的分类体系转化为结构化记录，涵盖危险的存在、类型以及推荐的高层策略。 该智能体既不会预测轨迹，也不会控制车辆；其生成的记录用于指导一个基于 VLM 的决策智能体。 在零样本实验中，这些提醒机制提升了策略准确性并减少了预警不足的情况。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous-driving planners have achieved strong performance on standard benchmarks, yet these benchmarks remain dominated by routine, low-risk scenes. Average-case performance therefore does not establish reliability under rare, safety-critical hazards, such as an occluded pedestrian entering the ego path or a collapsed road surface blocking the lane.
paragraphs.zh: 自动驾驶规划器在标准基准测试中取得了优异表现，但这些基准测试仍然主要由常规、低风险场景主导。 因此，平均情况下的表现并不能证明其在罕见且关乎安全的危险情况下的可靠性，例如被遮挡的行人进入本车路径，或路面塌陷导致车道受阻。

paragraphs.en: Existing resources provide limited support for controlled planner evaluation in such cases. Real-world datasets preserve realistic observations but contain few controllable hazards, whereas simulation introduces a domain gap. Corner-case datasets often target perception, anomaly recognition, or semantic reasoning rather than trajectory compliance. A planning benchmark should instead combine realistic scenes, controlled hazard insertion, paired source–edited observations, spatial hazard annotations, and trajectory-level evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 现有资源对这类情况中受控规划器的评估仅提供有限支持。 真实世界的数据集保留了逼真的观察数据，但包含的可控危险很少，而模拟则会引入领域差异。 边缘情况数据集通常侧重于感知、异常识别或语义推理，而非轨迹合规性。 相比之下，一个规划基准应结合真实场景、受控的危险插入、成对的源-编辑观察数据、空间危险标注以及轨迹层面的评估。

paragraphs.en: Hazard insertion also invalidates conventional trajectory supervision: the recorded human trajectory may intersect the new hazard and no longer provide a valid reference. Moreover, slowing, stopping, yielding, and bypassing may all be acceptable under different constraints. Each task should therefore define local safety constraints and a set of acceptable responses rather than prescribe a unique expert trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 危险物的引入也会使传统的轨迹监督失效：记录的人类轨迹可能与新的危险物相交，从而不再提供有效的参考。 此外，在不同约束条件下，减速、停止、让行和绕行都可能是可接受的选择。 因此，每个任务都应定义局部安全约束和一组可接受的响应，而不是规定唯一的专家轨迹。

paragraphs.en: We proposed ExceptionDrive , a planning-oriented counterfactual benchmark built by inserting localized hazards into real nuScenes observations. Its construction pipeline combines VLM-assisted scene screening, localized multi-view editing, quality review, and BEV hazard localization while preserving the surrounding context. The benchmark contains 21 tasks in six safety families . Overall, ExceptionDrive comprises 12,440 source–edited pairs : 3,181 quality-approved benchmark pairs and 9,259 auxiliary pairs. Source–edited pairs use identical model settings and non-visual inputs, allowing the effect of the localized edit to be isolated.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ExceptionDrive，这是一个规划导向的反事实基准数据集，通过将局部化危险插入真实的 nuScenes 观测数据中构建而成。 其构建流程结合了 VLM 辅助的场景筛选、局部化多视角编辑、质量审查和 BEV 危险定位，同时保留了周围的环境上下文。 该基准数据集包含六个安全类别中的 21 项任务。 总体而言，ExceptionDrive 由 12,440 对源-编辑数据组成：其中 3,181 对为通过质量审核的基准数据对，9,259 对为辅助数据对。 源-编辑数据对使用完全相同的模型设置和非视觉输入，从而能够孤立地评估局部化编辑所产生的影响。

paragraphs.en: Our hazard-centric protocol evaluates edited trajectories without expert references. Unsafe Rate (UR) measures core-region intrusion, and Hazard Clearance Compliance (HCC) measures compliance with the required clearance. Hazard Proximity Response (HPR) diagnoses clearance relative to the prescribed margin, while Counterfactual Trajectory Shift (CTS) measures the change between source and edited predictions. HCC and UR are the primary safety metrics; HPR and CTS are complementary diagnostics. The protocol evaluates local hazard compliance rather than complete route validity or closed-loop safety.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的以风险为中心的协议无需专家参考即可评估编辑后的轨迹。 不安全率（UR）衡量核心区域的侵入情况，而风险清除合规性（HCC）则衡量对规定清除距离的遵守程度。 风险邻近响应（HPR）根据规定的边界诊断清除情况，而反事实轨迹偏移（CTS）则衡量原始预测与编辑后预测之间的变化。 HCC 和 UR 是主要的安全指标；HPR 和 CTS 则是互补的诊断工具。 该协议评估的是局部风险合规性，而非完整路线的有效性或闭环安全性。

Without receiving sample-specific task labels or target strategies, the reminder supports high-level decision making but does not predict trajectories or control the vehicle.

paragraphs.en: We established a planning-oriented task taxonomy and hazard-centric evaluation framework. The framework organizes 21 tasks into six planning-safety families, defines each task through local safety constraints and acceptable risk-mitigation responses, and evaluates edited-scene trajectories without requiring expert reference trajectories. HCC, UR, HPR, and CTS respectively characterize clearance compliance, core-region intrusion, hazard-proximity response, and counterfactual trajectory change.
paragraphs.zh: 我们建立了一个以规划为导向的任务分类体系以及以风险为中心的评价框架。 该框架将 21 项任务组织为六个规划与安全类别，通过局部安全约束和可接受的风险缓解响应来定义每项任务，并且无需专家参考轨迹即可对编辑后的场景轨迹进行评估。 HCC、UR、HPR 和 CTS 分别表征了空间间隙合规性、核心区域侵入、风险邻近响应以及反事实轨迹变化。

sents.zh: 我们建立了一个以规划为导向的任务分类体系以及以风险为中心的评价框架。

sents.en: The framework organizes 21 tasks into six planning-safety families, defines each task through local safety constraints and acceptable risk-mitigation responses, and evaluates edited-scene trajectories without requiring expert reference trajectories.

paragraphs.en: We systematically evaluated representative planners using the proposed benchmark and reveal frequent failures in local hazard compliance. As an auxiliary application, we also introduced a lightweight Reminder Agent and found that structured task-grounded risk records improve high-level strategy accuracy and reduce under-warning in zero-shot VLM experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用所提出的基准对代表性规划器进行了系统性评估，并揭示了其在局部风险合规性方面的频繁失效。 作为一种辅助应用，我们还引入了一款轻量级的提醒智能体，并发现基于结构化任务的风险记录能够提升高层策略的准确性，同时减少零样本 VLM 实验中的预警不足问题。

paragraphs.en: An object- or appearance-based corner-case taxonomy is insufficient for planner evaluation because risk depends on the hazard’s location, its conflict with the ego vehicle, and the feasible responses. For example, the same vehicle may require stopping when it blocks the ego lane, yielding when it occupies an intersection conflict region, or performing a constrained bypass when sufficient adjacent space is available. Conversely, visually different hazards may impose the same planning constraint, such as avoiding a non-drivable region. Constructing planning-oriented counterfactual cases therefore requires an operational task specification that jointly defines the applicable driving context, the localized hazard intervention, the spatial safety constraint, and the range of acceptable risk-mitigation responses.
paragraphs.zh: 基于物体或外观的角点案例分类法不足以用于规划器评估，因为风险取决于危险物的位置、其与自身车辆的冲突关系以及可行的应对方式。 例如，同一辆车在阻挡自身车道时可能需要停车，在占据交叉口冲突区域时可能需要让行，或在相邻空间充足时执行受约束的绕行操作。 相反，外观不同的危险物可能施加相同的规划约束，例如避开不可驾驶区域。 因此，构建面向规划的虚拟反事实案例需要一种操作任务规范，该规范需共同定义适用的驾驶场景、局部化的危险物干预措施、空间安全约束以及可接受的风险缓解应对范围。

paragraphs.en: We define 21 tasks and organize them into six planning-safety families: Sudden Emergence , Lane Blockage , Bypass and Gap Conflict , Signal and Rule Conflict , Intersection Conflict , and Road-Surface Hazard . For each task, we specify scene-suitability conditions, rejection rules, edit content, target-location constraints, the corresponding hazard or conflict region, and acceptable risk-mitigation responses. These responses do not prescribe a single mandatory maneuver. Instead, they describe task-level options such as avoiding a localized risk region, stopping before a constraint boundary, yielding to conflicting traffic, or bypassing only when sufficient space is available. The resulting specifications provide a common basis for scene screening, localized editing, quality review, hazard-region construction, geometric planner evaluation, and high-level strategy evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们定义了 21 项任务，并将其组织为六个规划-安全类别：突发出现、车道阻塞、绕行与间隙冲突、信号与规则冲突、交叉口冲突以及路面危险。 对于每一项任务，我们都明确了场景适用性条件、拒绝规则、编辑内容、目标位置约束、对应的危险或冲突区域，以及可接受的风险缓解响应。 这些响应并未规定单一强制性的操作动作。 相反，它们描述了任务层面的选项，例如避开局部风险区域、在约束边界前停车、让行冲突交通，或在仅有足够空间时进行绕行。 由此产生的规范为场景筛选、局部编辑、质量审查、危险区域构建、几何规划器评估以及高层策略评估提供了共同基础。

paragraphs.en: For each scene–task combination, a VLM assesses whether the synchronized nuScenes views and scene description satisfy the task-specific suitability conditions. It examines the road layout, available space, occlusion pattern, and potential insertion location. For suitable combinations, the VLM selects the relevant views, specifies an ego-relative target location, and generates view-specific editing instructions. A combination is rejected if the hazard would violate task constraints, create an ambiguous planning conflict, or require substantial changes to the original scene.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个场景–任务组合，VLM 会评估同步的 nuScenes 视角和场景描述是否满足任务特定的适用性条件。 它会检查道路布局、可用空间、遮挡模式以及潜在的插入位置。 对于适用的组合，VLM 会选择相关的视角，指定一个以自我车辆为参照的目标位置，并生成针对每个视角的编辑指令。 如果该危险会违反任务约束、造成模糊的规划冲突，或需要对原始场景进行重大修改，则拒绝该组合。

For hazards visible in multiple synchronized views, view-specific instructions promote cross-view coherence, which is subsequently assessed during VLM review; no separate geometric multi-view consistency module is used. The resulting source–edited pair is intended to differ primarily in the inserted hazard.

paragraphs.en: Finally, we construct a hazard region H i H_{i} in ego coordinates for each accepted sample. BEVFormer-based localization Li et al. (2022b) provides four ground-plane corners defining H i H_{i} as a closed BEV quadrilateral. paragraphs.en: The planner evaluation described above diagnoses whether a predicted trajectory responds safely to a localized counterfactual hazard, but it does not directly provide an interpretable explanation of the detected risk. We therefore explore a secondary use of the ExceptionDrive taxonomy by constructing a lightweight task-grounded risk Reminder Agent for VLM-based driving agents. The Reminder Agent neither predicts trajectories nor controls the vehicle. Instead, it converts task-relevant visual evidence into a structured risk record that supports high-level driving strategy selection.
paragraphs.zh: 上述规划器评估能够诊断预测轨迹是否对局部反事实危险做出安全响应，但它并未直接提供对检测到的风险的可解释说明。 因此，我们通过构建一个基于任务的轻量级风险提醒智能体，来探索 ExceptionDrive 分类体系的第二种用途，该智能体专为基于 VLM 的驾驶智能体设计。 提醒智能体既不会预测轨迹，也不会控制车辆。 相反，它将任务相关的视觉证据转化为结构化的风险记录，从而支持高层驾驶策略的选择。

paragraphs.en: Given a driving scene, the reminder first identifies potential hazard evidence and associates it with the applicable risk definitions in the task taxonomy. It then produces a structured record containing hazard presence, hazard type, and a recommended high-level strategy. The reminder has access to the task taxonomy as a collection of risk definitions, but is not provided with the ground-truth task identity or its target strategy for the current sample. The final driving strategy is predicted by a VLM-based driving agent from a predefined strategy space, including actions such as maintaining the current path, slowing down, stopping, yielding, or preparing to bypass.

paragraphs.en: To support failure analysis, qualitative studies, and future expansion, we construct an auxiliary set in addition to the benchmark evaluation set. paragraphs.en: Fig. 5 presents representative planning cases and illustrates three common failure patterns. paragraphs.en: In this paper, we proposed ExceptionDrive , a planning oriented counterfactual benchmark for evaluating autonomous-driving planners under rare and safety-critical local hazards. ExceptionDrive constructs 21 tasks across six planning-safety families by inserting localized hazards into compatible real-world driving observations while preserving the original scene context. To address the absence of valid expert trajectories after hazard insertion, we proposed a hazard-centric evaluation protocol that assesses hazard intrusion, clearance compliance, avoidance response, and counterfactual behavioral changes. In addition, we developed a lightweight Reminder Agent to transform visual hazard evidence into structured risk records for high-level decision making. Experiments with representative planners demonstrate that existing systems frequently fail to maintain sufficient safety clearance, while the Reminder Agent improves zero-shot strategy prediction and reduces under-warning. These results highlight the value of ExceptionDrive for systematically analyzing planner behavior under localized visual interventions that are critical to safety.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 ExceptionDrive——一个面向规划的反事实基准测试，用于评估自动驾驶规划器在罕见且关乎安全的局部危险下的表现。 ExceptionDrive 通过在兼容的真实世界驾驶观测中插入局部化危险，同时保留原始场景上下文，构建了六个规划-安全类别中的 21 项任务。 为了解决危险插入后有效专家轨迹缺失的问题，我们提出了一种以危险为中心的评价协议，用于评估危险的侵入性、距离合规性、规避反应以及反事实行为变化。 此外，我们还开发了一个轻量级的提醒智能体，将视觉化的危险证据转化为结构化风险记录，以支持高层决策。 对典型规划器的实验表明，现有系统经常无法保持足够的安全距离，而提醒智能体则提升了零样本策略预测能力并减少了预警不足的情况。 这些结果凸显了 ExceptionDrive 的价值，它有助于系统性地分析规划器在局部视觉干预下的行为，而这些干预对安全至关重要。
